blocking_findings.summary: The textbook target 'Teken een P-Q-grafiek bij de tabel' is not the primary active graph-construction task.
The textbook sequence has nine cards where the target needs at most three.
Prompt/context blocks are rendered in the source pane instead of the task pane.
The completed graph is visible before the student is asked to draw the graph.
The graph workspace is not proven large enough for graph construction.
The actual-exam sequence has six cards where the target calculation needs three.
The transformation rewards many mapped task families instead of target-task economy.
